cim_eredeti: Tencent WeVisOne-VL Unifies Detection, OCR, Segmentation and Matting
szoveg_eredeti:
Tencent’s WeChat Vision team has released WeVisOne-VL , an open vision language model in 2B and 4B sizes. The WeVisOne-VL vision language model handles detection, referring, counting, pointing, OCR, segmentation and alpha matting in one model. Pixel outputs come from a 9.6M-parameter decoder, so no separate SAM is needed. It also answers “None” when a queried object is absent. For developers, that can replace a detector, an OCR engine and a segmenter with one model. 

 TL;DR 

 Size: 2B ( 2.44B params ) and 4B ( 4.83B params ) on Hugging Face, and a 9.6M-parameter pixel decoder. Trained with up to 8,192 tokens of context; deployment context length is not disclosed.

 Runs on: A single GPU through Transformers or vLLM in BF16. The package also lists NPU and CPU devices. VRAM needs are not disclosed. A community GGUF ran object-level tasks on a 6 GB RTX 2060.

 Performance: Beats the same-scale VLM baselines in Tencent’s tables on most of 30+ benchmarks (self-reported).

 Best: 71.3 F1 Mean on Dense200 dense detection, versus 58.7 for LocateAnything-3B.

 Worst: 52.6% rejection rate on PR-Bench, so many absent-target queries still get a box.

 What is WeVisOne-VL? 

 WeVisOne-VL (“WeChat Vision All-in-One”) is a perception-focused model from Tencent built on Qwen3-VL . It targets fine-grained localization rather than open-ended chat. Users choose the output granularity: points, boxes, binary masks or continuous alpha mattes.

 How does WeVisOne-VL work? 

 Every task is cast as structured next-token prediction. The model adds coordinate tokens <0> to <1000> for normalized boxes and points. An absent target produces None instead of a guessed box.

 For pixel tasks, the model emits an <OBJ> token after each predicted box. Its hidden state becomes a query for the pixel decoder, according to the model card . The decoder has 3 parts:

 Visual Feature Adapter: reuses multi-level Qwen3-VL ViT features instead of a second image encoder.

 Box-Guided Query Decoder: 6 deformable cross-attention blocks seeded by the <OBJ> state and the box.

 Dense Prediction Head: refines output at S/4, S/2 and S/1 into a full-resolution mask or matte.

 How was it trained? 

 A knowledge-graph-driven data engine annotated over 100M images with about 3.6B boxes. SAM3, Rex-Omni and an in-house detector proposed regions, and Qwen3-VL verified them.

 Training used 3 SFT stages. Stage 1 aligned output formats on 90M examples. Stage 2 raised input to 1,960 visual tokens and up to 500 boxes per response. Stage 3 trained the pixel decoder, then specialized it for matting on 130M samples. A final GRPO stage used 178K uncertainty-filtered examples, as described in the research paper .

 How does WeVisOne-VL perform on benchmarks? 

 All numbers below are self-reported, using greedy decoding and at most 1,960 visual tokens per image. Detection, referring and OCR use F1 averaged over IoU 0.5 to 0.95.

 Detection: 55.3 F1 on LVIS and 71.3 on Dense200 for the 4B model.

 Referring: 81.8 F1 on RefCOCOg test, versus 77.6 for LocateAnything-3B.

 Rejection: 96.4% on Tencent’s in-house WeRef-Bench (2,880 queries), versus 73.0%.

 Counting: 89.6% exact-match on PixMo-Count test, versus 82.8%.

 OCR: 52.0 F1 on TotalText, ahead of the PP-OCRv5 specialist at 25.7.

 Segmentation: 71.2 gIoU on ReasonSeg val, versus 65.0 for LISA-13B.

 Matting: 7.3 MAD on P3M-500-NP box prompts, versus 15.4 for SAM2-Matting (SAM3). Lower is better.

 The 2B model trails the 4B model on most tasks. It still scores better box-prompted matting on P3M-500-NP, at 6.6 MAD.

 How do you run WeVisOne-VL? 

 Weights for the 2B and 4B models are on Hugging Face. The wevisone_vl package wraps Transformers and vLLM backends. Tasks include detection , referring , point , count_box , ocr , segmentation and matting .

 from wevisone_vl import WeVisOneVL
model = WeVisOneVL("tencent/WeVisOne-VL-4B", backend="transformers") # or "vllm"
result = model.predict(image, task="matting", query="person")

 Hosted demos are live for 2B and 4B . Tencent also open-sourced Mask2Alpha , the matting annotator from its data engine. Fine-tuning code is still on the TODO list. GGUF builds cannot produce masks, since the decoder needs native visual features.

 Key Takeaways 

 1 model covers detection, OCR, counting, pointing, segmentation and matting.

 A 9.6M-parameter decoder replaces SAM for masks and alpha mattes.

 4B scores 71.3 F1 on Dense200, 12.6 points above LocateAnything-3B.

 Apache 2.0 weights, unlike non-commercial LocateAnything-3B.

cim: Minden vizuális AI-feladatot egyesít a Tencent új WeVisOne-VL modellje
lead: A Tencent nyílt forráskódú látásmodellt adott ki 2B és 4B méretben, amely tárgyfelismerésre, OCR-re és precíz képkivágásra is alkalmas.
osszefoglalo:
A Tencent WeChat Vision csapata közzétette a [WeVisOne-VL](https://github.com/Tencent/WeVisOne-VL) nevű nyílt forráskódú modellt, amely 2B és 4B paraméteres változatban érhető el az Apache 2.0 licenc alatt. Az eszköz egyetlen rendszerről kínál megoldást a tárgyfelismerésre, a szövegolvasásra (OCR), a darabszámlálásra, a szegmentálásra és az **alpha matting** finomkivágási feladatokra.

A fejlesztés alapja a Qwen3-VL modell, amit a Tencent egy 9,6 millió paraméteres pixel dekóderrel egészített ki. Ez a megközelítés feleslegessé teszi különálló szegmentáló modellek, például a SAM használatát, mivel a képpont alapú maszkokat és a finom körbevágásokat a rendszer közvetlenül állítja elő.

A WeVisOne-VL a Tesztmérések során felülmúlta a hasonló méretű vizuális nyelvi modelleket. Ha a keresett objektum nem található a képen, a rendszer nem tippel tévesen, hanem határozott **None** választ ad vissza a fejlesztőknek.
miert_szamit: A marketingesek és kreatív szakemberek számára ez a modell **több különálló képfeldolgozó eszközt vált ki egyetlen nyílt kódú megoldással**, ami jelentősen felgyorsíthatja a képszerkesztési és tartalomkezelési automatizációkat.

prioritas.indok: Hasznos, nyílt forráskódú vizuális nyelvi modell a Tencen től, ami több látásmodult egyesít. Forrás-tapasztalat: -8.
